description: CO2 compression to supercritical state + pipeline pressure drop; dense-phase pipeline
source: IPCC (2005) CCS Special Report, Chapter 4; IEA GHG (2011) CCS Cost Network; McCoy & Rubin (2008) Energy & Environmental Science

compressor.name: Multi-stage CO2 compressor with intercooling to supercritical

n_stages.note: Typical: 4-6 stages to reach 150 bar from 1 bar capture stream

polytropic_index.note: CO2 polytropic exponent (gamma=1.29 near critical, ~1.30 effective)

eta_polytropic.note: Polytropic stage efficiency for centrifugal CO2 compressor

T_inlet.note: 35°C inlet, well above critical T=304.2K to avoid two-phase

gamma.note: Near critical; use 1.30 for polytropic model

JT_coefficient_dense.note: JT coeff in dense/supercritical phase: NEGATIVE (warming on expansion above T_inv)

SEC_ref.note: Literature benchmark: ~80-120 kWh/tCO2 for full compression 1->150 bar (IPCC 2005)
